lines.text: Malachi says Judah has broken faith, and an abomination has been committed in Israel and in Jerusalem.
Judah has profaned the LORD's beloved sanctuary by marrying the daughter of a foreign god.
Malachi says the LORD may cut off from the tents of Levi everyone who is awake and aware.
The people cover the altar with tears, and the LORD witnessed between them and the wife of their youth.
The LORD seeks wealthy offspring, hates divorce, and says the man who divorces covers his garment with violence.
